name: Multiresolution Atlas Buffer (MAB)
definition: An acceleration wrapper for direct volume rendering (DVR) in VR that reduces ray density adaptively based on peripheral vision and HMD lens distortion, then reconstructs the full-resolution image via compositing.
summary: The Multiresolution Atlas Buffer is a VR DVR acceleration wrapper that adaptively reduces ray density based on gaze and lens distortion, then composites a full-resolution image without requiring eye-tracking hardware.
